verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ يَارَبُّ، بِقُوَّتِكَ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمَلِكُ، وَبِخَلَاصِكَ كَيْفَ لَا يَبْتَهِجُ جِدًّا!
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

verses.ar: شَهْوَةَ قَلْبِهِ أَعْطَيْتَهُ، وَمُلْتَمَسَ شَفَتَيْهِ لَمْ تَمْنَعْهُ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.web: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَتَقَدَّمُهُ بِبَرَكَاتِ خَيْرٍ. وَضَعْتَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ تَاجًا مِنْ إِبْرِيزٍ.
verses.kjv: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.web: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

verses.ar: حَيَاةً سَأَلَكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ. طُولَ ٱلْأَيَّامِ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: He asked life of thee, [and] thou gavest [it] him, [even] length of days for ever and ever.
verses.web: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

verses.ar: عَظِيمٌ مَجْدُهُ بِخَلَاصِكَ، جَلَالًا وَبَهَاءً تَضَعُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: His glory [is] great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.web: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ جَعَلْتَهُ بَرَكَاتٍ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. تُفَرِّحُهُ ٱبْتِهَاجًا أَمَامَكَ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.web: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْمَلِكَ يَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ، وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ لَا يَتَزَعْزَعُ.
verses.kjv: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.web: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

verses.ar: تُصِيبُ يَدُكَ جَمِيعَ أَعْدَائِكَ. يَمِينُكَ تُصِيبُ كُلَّ مُبْغِضِيكَ.
verses.kjv: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.web: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

verses.ar: تَجْعَلُهُمْ مِثْلَ تَنُّورِ نَارٍ فِي زَمَانِ حُضُورِكَ. ٱلرَّبُّ بِسَخَطِهِ يَبْتَلِعُهُمْ وَتَأْكُلُهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.web: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

verses.ar: تُبِيدُ ثَمَرَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ بَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.web: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ نَصَبُوا عَلَيْكَ شَرًّا. تَفَكَّرُوا بِمَكِيدَةٍ. لَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُوهَا.
verses.kjv: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, [which] they are not able [to perform].
verses.web: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَجْعَلُهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ. تُفَوِّقُ ٱلسِّهَامَ عَلَى أَوْتَارِكَ تِلْقَاءَ وُجُوهِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, [when] thou shalt make ready [thine arrows] upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.web: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

verses.ar: ٱرْتَفِعْ يَارَبُّ بِقُوَّتِكَ. نُرَنِّمْ وَنُنَغِّمْ بِجَبَرُوتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: [so] will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.web: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
